features: CHARGING CAPACITY: With a 10,000mAh battery capacity, this compact power bank delivers efficient charging.
MAGSAFE COMPATIBLE: MagSafe compatibility enhances convenience for Apple users, providing a secure and efficient wireless charging experience with MagSafe-enabled iPhones and accessories.
OUTPUT POWER: Efficiently charges a range of compatible devices with an output power of 22.5W and 15W max(Wireless output).

MULTIPLE OUTPUTS: Distinguished by its 5x Outputs including DC 5V/3A, 9V/2.22A,12V/1.67A, 3.3~11V/2A PPSType-C cable / Port Output, DC 5V/3A, 9V/2A,12V/1.85A USB A port Output, DC 5V/2A Lightning Cable Output, it facilitates the charging of multiple devices.
INPUT CONNECTIVITY: Comes with 3 inputs - DC 5V/3A, 9V/2A,12V/1.5A Type-C cable / Port Input and DC 5V/2.4A, 9V/2A Lightning Port Input.
